meaning.en: Fans abnormal stopped during startup sequence
meaning.ur: Startup sequence ke dauran fans abnormal taur par band ho gaye.

causes.en: Fans abnormal stopped during startup sequence
causes.ur: Startup sequence ke dauran fans abnormal taur par band ho gaye.

causes.en: Fan connector loose, or fan wiring open/broken behind the unit.
causes.ur: Fan ka connector dhila hai, ya unit ke peeche fan ki wiring khuli ya tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Fan motor seized or burnt (bearing jammed or coil open).
causes.ur: Fan motor jam ho gayi hai ya jal gayi hai (bearing phansa hua hai ya coil khuli hai).

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off and isolate the AC supply plus PV/battery DC before opening the case.
solutions.ur: Case kholne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC supply ke saath PV aur battery DC bhi alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check every fan connector for looseness or burn marks, then turn each fan blade by hand - it must spin free; clear dust or a jammed blade.
solutions.ur: Har fan ka connector check karein ke dhila ya jale hue nishaan to nahi; phir har fan ki blade haath se ghuma kar dekhein ke bilkul azaad ghoom rahi hai - dhag ya phansi hui cheez nikaal dein.

solutions.en: If a fan does not spin or its motor reads open on a meter, replace that fan, refit the connectors, restart and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Koi fan ghoomay ya meter par uska motor open aaye to woh fan badal dein, connectors wapas lagayein, restart karke confirm karein ke code chala gaya.

meaning.en: PV array voltage above operating limit
meaning.ur: PV array ka voltage operating limit se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: PV array voltage above operating limit
causes.ur: PV array ka voltage operating limit se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage too high for a cold morning (voltage rises as temperature drops).
causes.ur: Thandi subah mein string ka open-circuit voltage bohat zyada ho jata hai (temperature kam hone par voltage barhta hai).

causes.en: Too many panels wired in series for the inverter PV input range.
causes.ur: Inverter ke PV input range se zyada panels series mein jore gaye hain.

solutions.en: Isolate the PV DC input (open the PV breaker/switch) before touching any PV wiring.
solutions.ur: PV wiring chune se pehle PV DC input alag kar dein (PV breaker/switch band kar dein).

solutions.en: Measure the PV string voltage with a meter on the DC range and compare it with the PV input limit; the panels must be configured lower than 450V.
solutions.ur: Meter ke DC range par PV string ka voltage naapein aur PV input limit se compare karein; panels 450V se neeche set hone chahiye.

solutions.en: If the reading is still above limit with the correct string size, check for a parallel string or a failing panel and get the array re-checked before restarting.
solutions.ur: String size theek hone par bhi reading limit se upar aaye to parallel string ya kharab panel check karein aur restart se pehle array dobara check karwayein.

meaning.en: Over-voltage condition on utility/PV re-apply; possible internal charger problem
meaning.ur: Utility ya PV dobara lagane par over-voltage; andaruni charger mein masla ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Over-voltage condition on utility/PV re-apply; possible internal charger problem
causes.ur: Utility ya PV dobara lagane par over-voltage; andaruni charger mein masla ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Battery fully charged and charger not cutting off at the absorption/float point.
causes.ur: Battery full charge ho chuki hai aur charger absorption/float point par cut-off nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Utility supply came back high on re-apply, above the charger cut-off window.
causes.ur: Dobara apply karte waqt utility supply kaafi zyada aayi, jo charger cut-off window se upar thi.

solutions.en: Disconnect the Utility and PV power, then re-apply again.
solutions.ur: Utility aur PV power alag karein, phir dobara apply karein.

solutions.en: If the over-voltage alarm still sounds, the internal charger may have a problem — contact service center.
solutions.ur: Agar over-voltage alarm abhi bhi baj raha ho to andaruni charger kharab ho sakta hai, service center se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: Battery voltage discharge/protection threshold se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage below discharge/protection threshold
causes.ur: Battery voltage discharge/protection threshold se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or left unused for a long time.
causes.ur: Battery bohat zyada discharge ho chuki hai ya lambi der se band pari thi.

causes.en: Loose or corroded battery terminals causing a voltage drop under load.
causes.ur: Battery ke terminals dhile ya zang lage hue hain jis se load par voltage drop ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off and isolate the AC supply before testing the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals test karne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage with a meter at rest, tighten and clean the terminals, charge the battery, then restart and watch if the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery ka voltage rest par naapein, terminals ko tight aur saaf karein, battery ko charge karein, phir restart karke dekhein ke fault chala gaya ya nahi.

meaning.en: Short circuit condition on the load
meaning.ur: Load par short circuit ki halat ban gayi hai.

causes.en: Short circuit condition on the load
causes.ur: Load par short circuit ki halat ban gayi hai.

causes.en: Load wiring shorted to neutral or earth (damaged cable, moisture, rat bite).
causes.ur: Load ki wiring neutral ya earth se short ho gayi hai (cable toota, nami ya chuha ka kaat).

causes.en: A faulty appliance on the output drawing short-circuit current.
causes.ur: Output par koi kharab appliance short-circuit current kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Check and verify whether any load is short-circuited; remove the load and restart.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke koi load short-circuit to nahi; load hata kar restart karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists, contact service center.
solutions.ur: Masla phir bhi bana rahe to service center se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: Output par over-voltage aa jana

causes.en: Output over-voltage
causes.ur: Output par over-voltage aa jana

causes.en: AC output voltage setting too high for the connected load.
causes.ur: Load ke liye AC output voltage setting bohat zyada set kar di gayi hai.

causes.en: Voltage feedback/sense path drifted or feedback components failed.
causes.ur: Voltage feedback/sense path drift kar gaya hai ya feedback components kharab ho gaye hain.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and isolate the AC supply before probing the output.
solutions.ur: Output probe karne se pehle load alag karein aur AC supply isolate kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a meter and check the AC output voltage setting against the load requirement, then set it back to the correct value.
solutions.ur: Meter se output voltage naapein aur AC output voltage setting ko load ki zaroorat se compare karein, phir setting ko wapas sahi value par set karein.

solutions.en: If output voltage is still high at no-load, restart the unit; if the problem persists contact the service center - the feedback/sense path may be faulty.
solutions.ur: Khali load par bhi output voltage zyada aaye to unit restart karein; masla bana rahe to service center se rabta karein - feedback/sense path kharab ho sakta hai.

meaning.ur: Output par under-voltage aa jana

causes.en: Output under-voltage
causes.ur: Output par under-voltage aa jana

causes.en: Heavy load pulling the output voltage down below the limit.
causes.ur: Zyada load ki wajah se output voltage limit se neeche gir raha hai.

causes.en: Loose output wiring or a failing output filter capacitor.
causes.ur: Output ki wiring dhili hai ya output filter capacitor kharab ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply and remove part of the load before checking the output.
solutions.ur: Output check karne se pehle AC supply isolate karein aur kuch load hata dein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a meter under load, check the output connections are tight and not burnt, and reduce the load below the inverter rating.
solutions.ur: Meter se load par output voltage naapein, check karein ke output connections tight hain aur jale hue nahi hain, aur load ko inverter rating se neeche la kar kam karein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the reading is still low with a light load, contact the service center.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; halka load hone par bhi reading kam aaye to service center se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: DC bus par over-voltage aa jana

causes.en: DC bus over-voltage
causes.ur: DC bus par over-voltage aa jana

causes.en: Energy fed back into the DC bus by a regenerative load.
causes.ur: Regenerative load wapas energy DC bus par daal raha hai.

causes.en: DC bus discharge/bleeder path not working, so bus cannot bleed down.
causes.ur: DC bus ki discharge/bleeder path kaam nahi kar rahi, is liye bus neeche nahi utarti.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and isolate AC plus PV/battery DC before opening the case - the DC bus holds high voltage.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur case kholne se pehle AC ke saath PV aur battery DC bhi alag kar lein - DC bus par high voltage rehta hai.

solutions.en: Leave the unit off for a while so the bus can discharge, then measure the DC bus with a meter before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch der ke liye unit band rakhein taake bus discharge ho jaye, phir kuch chune se pehle meter se DC bus naapein.

solutions.en: Restart and monitor; if high bus voltage returns immediately, contact the service center - the discharge/bleeder path or feedback may be faulty.
solutions.ur: Restart karke nazar rakhein; high bus voltage foran wapas aaye to service center se rabta karein - discharge/bleeder path ya feedback kharab ho sakta hai.

meaning.ur: DC bus par under-voltage aa jana

causes.en: DC bus under-voltage
causes.ur: DC bus par under-voltage aa jana

causes.en: Input supply sagging or battery voltage too low under load.
causes.ur: Input supply gir raha hai ya load par battery voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Loose DC input connections or a weak DC link capacitor.
causes.ur: DC input ke connections dhile hain ya DC link capacitor kamzor ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply and check the DC input connections before probing.
solutions.ur: Probe karne se pehle AC supply isolate karein aur DC input ke connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery/PV input voltage with a meter and confirm the DC input terminals, breakers and cables are tight and not corroded.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery/PV input voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke DC input terminals, breakers aur cables tight hain aur zang nahi lage.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the bus voltage still sags with normal input, contact the service center.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; normal input ke bawajood bus voltage phir bhi girta rahe to service center se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: PV input ka current limit se upar chala gaya

causes.en: PV input current above limit
causes.ur: PV input ka current limit se upar chala gaya

causes.en: Shorted or failed PV panel, or damaged string wiring raising input current.
causes.ur: Panel short ho gaya ya string ki wiring kharab hai jis se input current barh raha hai.

causes.en: MPPT not tracking correctly, pushing too much current into the bus.
causes.ur: MPPT theek se track nahi kar raha jis se bus mein zyada current ja raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the PV DC input by opening the PV breaker before touching any PV wiring.
solutions.ur: PV wiring chune se pehle PV breaker khol kar PV DC input alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV input current with a meter or clamp and check the string for a shorted panel, damaged cable or wrong parallel connection.
solutions.ur: Meter ya clamp se PV input current naapein aur string mein short panel, kharab cable ya ghalat parallel connection check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the string and restart; if over-current returns on a healthy array, contact the service center.
solutions.ur: String theek karke restart karein; theek array par bhi over-current wapas aaye to service center se rabta karein.

meaning.ur: Inverter stage par over-current aa jana

causes.en: Inverter stage over-current
causes.ur: Inverter stage par over-current aa jana

causes.en: Overloaded or shorted load current reaching the inverter stage.
causes.ur: Load ka over-load ya short-circuit current inverter stage tak pahunch gaya hai.

causes.en: Faulty IGBT/MOSFET or gate driver fault in the inverter bridge.
causes.ur: Inverter bridge ka IGBT/MOSFET kharab hai ya gate driver mein fault hai.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and isolate AC and DC supply before opening the case - the inverter stage carries high current.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur case kholne se pehle AC aur DC dono supply alag kar lein - inverter stage mein high current chalta hai.

solutions.en: Check the output for a short or heavy load and measure the load current with a meter clamp, then remove the excessive load.
solutions.ur: Output par short ya zyada load check karein aur meter clamp se load current naapein, phir zyada wala load hata dein.

solutions.en: Restart with the load removed; if the fault comes back, contact the service center to check the inverter bridge and driver.
solutions.ur: Load hata kar restart karein; fault wapas aaye to service center se rabta karein taake inverter bridge aur driver check hon.

causes.ur: Discharge path par over-current aa jana

causes.en: Discharge current higher than the battery/inverter rating.
causes.ur: Discharge current battery ya inverter ki rating se zyada chal raha hai.

causes.en: Battery bank too small for the load, or one cell shorted.
causes.ur: Battery bank ki capacity load ke liye choti hai ya koi cell short ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off and isolate AC supply plus battery DC before testing.

solutions.ur: Meter clamp se discharge current naapein aur battery cables, terminals aur load par short ya zyada load check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load and restart; if the over-current still shows, contact the service center.

meaning.ur: Zyada garmi / hawa ka rasta band / ganda filter

causes.en: Over-temperature / poor ventilation / clogged filter
causes.ur: Zyada garmi / hawa ka rasta band / ganda filter

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high, or the unit installed in a closed space.
causes.ur: Aas paas ka temperature bohat zyada hai ya unit band jagah mein lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan slow or stopped, or heatsink fins choked with dust.
causes.ur: Cooling fan slow chal raha hai ya band ho gaya, ya heatsink fins dhag se band hain.

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let it cool down while keeping the supply isolated.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur supply alag rakhte hue use thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Clean the anti-dust filter and the heatsink, confirm the cooling fan runs and the unit stands in a well-ventilated place.
solutions.ur: Anti-dust filter aur heatsink saaf karein, confirm karein ke cooling fan chal raha hai aur unit khuli hawa wali jagah par khadi hai.

solutions.en: Restart and watch the temperature; if the fault appears again soon, contact the service center.
solutions.ur: Restart karke temperature par nazar rakhein; thodi der mein fault dobara aaye to service center se rabta karein.

causes.en: Gate driver or protection circuit blocking the inverter from starting.

meaning.ur: Output mein DC offset zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Excessive DC offset in output
causes.ur: Output mein DC offset zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Output filter or sensing components drifted, raising the DC offset.
causes.ur: Output filter ya sensing components drift kar gaye hain jis se DC offset barh gaya hai.

causes.en: Failed output capacitor, or wrong current-sense offset calibration.
causes.ur: Output capacitor kharab ho gaya hai ya current-sense offset ki calibration ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC supply and disconnect the load before measuring the output.
solutions.ur: Output naapne se pehle AC supply isolate karein aur load alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the DC component of the output with a meter in DC mode across the output terminals, and check the output wiring and filter capacitors for damage.

causes.ur: BMS communication disconnect ho gayi (manual: sirf tab jab battery type "AGM", "Flooded" ya "User-Defined" na ho).

causes.en: After battery connected, communication signal not detected for 3 minutes → buzzer beeps; after 10 minutes inverter stops charging/discharging to lithium battery.
causes.ur: Battery connect hone ke baad 3 minute tak communication signal detect nahi hota to buzzer beep karta hai; 10 minute baad inverter lithium battery ko charge/discharge karna band kar deta hai.

causes.en: If communication lost after a successful connection, buzzer beeps immediately.
causes.ur: Agar connection hone ke baad communication chali jaye to buzzer foran beep karta hai.

solutions.en: Contact service center to repair.
solutions.ur: Repair ke liye service center se rabta karein.
